2014_spells.chain-lightning.description: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target can be a creature or an object and can be targeted by only one of the bolts. A target must make a dexterity saving throw. The target takes 10d8 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
2014_spells.chain-lightning.effectSummar: Deal 10d8 lightning damage to a target within 150 ft
2014_spells.chain-lightning.fullDescript: Using 1 action, you create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range. The target takes 10d8 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; A target must make a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, one additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each slot level above 6th. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
